Selflesness, skill, and sacrifice. These three traits are requisite for any supporting role, and are lacking in pretty much all wizards. -#ITEM_vs_staff06; -#ITEM_vs_weapon06;
据说牧羊女曾用它勾到胡迪警长 (玩具总动员)为啥僵尸手上会有？ #PA;无 #AA;范围撒毒

Legend has it that staves like this sometimes appear through portals at the end of the world. Others say that they were crafted by wizards lacking proper social abilities, and with too much time on their hands. #PA;None #AA;Radioactive Discharge
本想做成可以引导奥术能量的神器， 结果材料方面不允许...好吧， 只好用于肉搏战啦 -偶尔用来当晾衣架 #PA;无 #AA;“我最摇摆！”

Standard wizard staves are never used in close combat, as wizards are afraid such abuse might compromise the stave's ability to channel arcane energies and elements. This staff, however, is crafted from poor materials with no obvious practical use. Thus, many wizards use it in melee -- and occasionally to hang up their laundry. #PA;None #AA;Sucker Swing
人们深信这根法杖是在龙之世纪打造的，但是关于它的起源还有众多谜团。只有很少很少的巫师使用过它，并且传说只有身体内流着龙族之血的巫师才有能力驾驭它。不过，传说这东西也有很多是非常愚蠢的。 #PA;无 #AA;召唤喷火鳄

This staff is believed to have been crafted during the Dragon Age, but much about its origins remains unknown. Few wizards have ever been seen wielding it, and legend has it that it can only be wielded by wizards with dragon's blood running through their veins. On the other hand, legend has lots of silly nonsense. #PA;None #AA;Summon Firedrake
转职近战战士的法师你伤不起！ #PA;显著降低法伤 #AA;盾牌冲击

The standard issue GSP was never meant to be wielded by wizards, and only less talented wizards would ever resort to the use of reinforced iron to fend off enemy attacks. It has proven to be surprisingly useful in wizard duels, but is rather a liability when the casting of spells becomes necessary. #PA;Significantly decreased spell efficiency #AA;Shieldbash
尽管被许多人不齿，但烟雾弹 逃生具备非常高的实用性，好比让 一只兽人在高速公路收费站工作... #PA;无 #AA;制造烟雾向后退

Though they are considered cowardly by many, Smoke Bombs are perfect for creating distractions, and relocating yourself quickly in the face of imminent danger, such as high velocity projectiles and charging Beastmen. #PA;None #AA;Smoke and shadowstep
人人有奶喝，人人有肉吃， 好男人就是我，我就是奶爸！ #PA;降低法伤,范围支持光环 #AA;无

The crystal cores of these staves have been intentionally compromised, to allowing their magical energies to seep out and find their way into other nearby crystals. This makes the staff itself inferior to others, but any wizards in the presense of the cracked crystal find their own staves far more potent. #PA;Decreased spell efficiency, Spell boosting aura #AA;None
A handgun that has been in use since 1911.
独自生存在都市深处的巫师常常 会使用这种奇怪的神兵利器 #DMG;低物理伤害 #SP;范围攻击
Wizards who have left Aldrheim and live outside the laws of society can occasionally be seen using such strange but formidable weapons. #DMG;Low #SP;Ranged
在巫师城堡的某个箱子里发现的 先进武器，已被设定为闪电攻击. #DMG;无 #SP;电击昏迷

A ridicously advanced piece of equipment found in a crate in the basement of Castle Aldrheim. The Phaser apparantly has many different functions, but the wizards of Aldrheim have made sure that it is permanently set to stun. #DMG;None #SP;Lightning Stuns
这把沉重而残忍的巨剑是无法通过魔法来锻造的。它剑身上雕刻着古代符文，钢材天然形成却又坚硬无比。 #DMG;高 #SP;慢
This heavy and brutal sword could not have been forged by the Wizard Order. It is inscribed with ancient runes, and the steel is of a crude but very solid quality. #DMG;High #SP;Slow
我很笨可是我很坚韧， 我很丑可是我很温柔 #DMG;低物伤+慢速 #SP;无
These swords are designed for the least talented wizards of Aldrheim. They are even more blunted than usual, for that extra bit of protection. #DMG;Low, Slow #SP;None
小巧便捷的快速式毒箭弓弩,无需 很大手劲也能使用,深受巫师喜爱 #DMG;低物理伤害 #SP;毒箭

The Compact Crossbow is a small, portable version of the classic Crossbow, which is never used by wizards owing to the strength required to load it. This one, however, is designed to suit wizards perfectly. The Compact Crossbow comes with a fancy wrist attachment. Each arrow must be poisoned separately. #DMG;Low #SP;Poisonous arrows
合格的奶爸拥有美丽心灵,他们的 手能够治愈一切,而不是握着刀剑 #DMG;极低物伤 #SP;无

A wizard filling the supporting role is often a very gentle soul, and uncomfortable with the idea of harming others. He feels that his hands were made for better things than hoisting a blade. #DMG;Very low #SP;None
